systems.owner: INTERPOL programme funded by the European Union; premises for the DACORE allocated by the authorities in Chad
systems.tiers: as of August 2019: scanning stations rolled out in Chad, the premises for the national centre (DACORE) refurbished and awaiting servers in the next few weeks; no unit named and no entry of data reported

note: No fact: Chad has one sentence, in the head of programme's conclusion, on scanning stations rolled out and the centre's premises awaiting servers in August 2019; nothing says what the system records or that a station enters reports or cases, so it has no class.
